# Who Is Missing, and Which Model Do You Keep?

Every real dataset has holes, and every model is a choice among many. This week covers both, in the order your final project meets them. First, the missing data: why the **reason** a value is missing matters more than how many are missing, how to check what you can, and when listwise deletion is fine versus when you need multiple imputation. Then, the model: building it in **planned blocks**, comparing the blocks with Δ*R*², AIC, and BIC, and seeing why a model chosen by looking at the data needs new data to test it. That last point is the reason your project has a holdout.

The in-class activity is a dress rehearsal for M2 and your memo's model-building section, on the DASS data you already know.
